verdict.rationale: Mollie Connect is documented for platforms and marketplaces. Split payments hold buyer funds in a marketplace holding balance and distribute set amounts to each connected seller's balance while the platform keeps a commission. Application fees (flat and/or percentage) move automatically to the platform. Merchant onboarding is referenced, with onboarding-status webhook events and OAuth app tokens for acting on behalf of connected customers. Missing for 10: detailed onboarding/KYC flow documentation, explicit evidence of payouts from seller balances to seller bank accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
